clue.text: Yellow bananas artist's used in curry

parts.note: yellow is slang for cowardly, as is chicken
bananas is slang for crazy, mad
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist; with the 's it gives RAS

explanation.surface: Ripe yellow bananas that a painter has thrown into a curry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yellow' and 'bananas' look like fruit description but both are slang: cowardly and crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: A chicken madras is a hot Indian-restaurant curry dish made with poultry.

clue.text: Bribe with some mushrooms cooked in nectar

indicators.note: in places the scrambled letters inside the word for nectar

parts.note: nectar is the sweet stuff bees make into honey; honey stands for it here

indicators.note: cooked signals the chosen letters are mixed up
some of the word mushrooms, its first four letters, is used

explanation.surface: A recipe: some mushrooms cooked in honey, offered as a bribe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' keeps only the front of mushrooms; 'cooked' looks like part of the recipe but signals the rearrangement, giving USHM to set in the nectar word.
explanation.definitionFit: Money paid to keep someone quiet is a bribe for silence.

clue.text: Equestrian's aim is to jump over a given route

parts.note: to clear a fence is to jump over it
a round is a set route, like a milkman's round

explanation.surface: A show-jumper's goal is to get over every fence on a set course.
explanation.definitionFit: In show-jumping a faultless circuit with no fences knocked down is what every rider is aiming for.

clue.text: English singer taken in by my diplomatic setting

indicators.note: taken in by means the following pieces go inside the word my

parts.note: a bass is a low-voiced male singer

explanation.surface: An English vocalist is welcomed inside by the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambassador's official residence and offices form the setting where diplomacy is conducted.

clue.text: See 1
A former name for country home or area across Turkey & Armenia

parts.note: Siam is the old name of Thailand
being in means being at home

explanation.surface: A geography question: an old country name or a region spanning Turkey and Armenia.
explanation.definitionFit: The Anatolian peninsula, the historic region covering most of modern Turkey and stretching toward Armenia.

clue.text: Indian dish author mentioned in conversation

indicators.note: mentioned in conversation says the word is to be heard, said out loud

parts.note: an author is a writer

explanation.surface: A dish named after a novelist comes up in chat.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent 'writer' and the dish sound almost the same.
explanation.definitionFit: A yoghurt-and-cucumber side dish served with Indian meals.

clue.text: He's let toilets get out of order — they might make women look down on him

definitions.text: they might make women look down on him

indicators.note: out of order means the letters are put in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A man who lets the toilets break down earns women's scorn.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests contempt; the definition is literal: tall heels raise women so they look down on a man.
explanation.definitionFit: Very high, thin heels add height to the wearer, so she physically looks down on a shorter man.

clue.text: Hypochondriac speaking: "I'm ill, doctor!"

parts.note: points to the comedian whose gravestone famously reads 'I told you I was ill'; the second word also holds I'M ILL

explanation.surface: A worried patient insists to the GP that they are sick.
explanation.walkthrough: The Goon Show comic's epitaph, in Irish, says 'I told you I was ill'; his surname also begins with the letters of 'I'm ill'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish-born comedian was noted for jokes about his own health, ending with that headstone joke.

clue.text: Potential witness placing king in "old hat" (Times)

indicators.note: placing tells us one piece is set into another
in says where the king goes: between the two following pieces

parts.note: old hat means out of date, passé
by means times, as in three by four
R is short for rex, king

explanation.surface: A newspaper story about a monarch put in an out-of-fashion hat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper but is the multiplication word.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who happens to be walking past could see an incident and be called as a witness.

clue.text: Costume no good for cycling, one concludes

indicators.note: concludes means this piece comes at the end
no means without, so the letter for good is dropped

parts.note: cycling is biking
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone decides an outfit is useless for riding a bike.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-piece swimming costume, swimsuit being the British sense of costume.

clue.text: Start of Plimsoll line? It's at front of ship

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of the word Plimsoll

parts.note: a row is a line

explanation.surface: A query about the Plimsoll line, the load mark painted on a ship's hull.
explanation.definitionFit: The pointed forward part of a vessel's hull, the bow.

clue.text: Communists worked out Greek humour's not for everyone

indicators.note: worked out signals the combined letters are rearranged
not means without, so the letter for everyone is taken away

parts.note: the 's is short for is, a link; humour gives its letters
U is the film certificate for a universal audience, suitable for everyone

explanation.surface: A judgment that Greek comedy is an acquired taste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes U from HUMOUR leaving HUMOR; with GREEK, 'worked out' rearranges the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cambodian communist movement led by Pol Pot that ruled from 1975 to 1979.

clue.text: Special constable having drink before game dealt with disorderly struggle

parts.note: SC is the abbreviation for special constable, a volunteer police officer
rum is a drink

indicators.note: dealt with, like cards dealt out, signals the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A part-time police officer has a drink before handling a match.
explanation.definitionFit: A scramble or tussle, as in the rugby term for a pushing contest of forwards.

clue.text: Smart, bad-tempered brief

definitions.meaning: a ... dresser is smartly turned out
a ... dog or person is irritable
a ... reply is short and punchy

explanation.surface: Three adjectives describing a curt, well-dressed person.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers stylishness, irritability and terseness, each a common usage.

clue.text: Communists managing to blur boundaries of ownership around Italy

indicators.note: around says the reworked letters enclose the letter for Italy
managing suggests the letters are handled into a new order
boundaries of picks the outer letters of ownership

parts.note: I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: Party officials obscuring who owns what in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'managing' rearranges TO BLUR plus O and P (the edges of ownership) into POLTBURO, which goes 'around' I.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief policy-making committee of a communist party, so a body of communists.

clue.text: Fastener that's easily tightened hairpiece around top of nun's head

indicators.note: around says the hairpiece word encloses the next letter

parts.note: a wig is a hairpiece

indicators.note: top of picks the first letter of nun's

parts.note: nut is slang for head

explanation.surface: A wig fitted around a nun's head and fastened tight.
explanation.definitionFit: A threaded bolt fixing with two flat wings for turning by hand, so it is tightened easily.

clue.text: Go into city with prisoner, given lift during the night

indicators.note: into says the word for go is put inside
given lift in a down clue means read upwards, back to front

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
con is short for convict, a prisoner
a go is a turn

explanation.surface: Someone enters a city with a convict who has been given a ride at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Of or happening at night, as nocturnal animals are active in the dark hours.

clue.text: See 9
Scilly Diving's offering is flipping wonderful

indicators.note: flipping means the run of letters is read backwards
offering means the words present a run of letters from inside them

explanation.surface: A dive school in the Scilly Isles advertises a wonderful experience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild oath before 'wonderful' but turns the letters CILLYDI round.
explanation.definitionFit: Idyllic describes a perfect, peaceful scene, so wonderful in a pastoral way.

clue.text: Trim cuff around the edge

parts.note: C is short for circa, around
a lip is an edge, as of a cup

explanation.surface: Instructions to trim a shirt cuff around its edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cuff' is a second definition: a clip round the ear is a cuff.
explanation.definitionFit: To clip a hedge or hair is to trim it by cutting.

clue.text: Copper getting risqué in clergyman's office

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
racy means risqué

explanation.surface: A policeman turns saucy in a vicar's study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' looks like a police officer but is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: The post held by a curate, an assistant parish priest.

clue.text: A trick a conjuror started up in short break during poetry recital

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: a ruse is a trick

indicators.note: started picks the first letter of conjuror

explanation.surface: A magician performs a trick during a break in a poetry reading.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause in the middle of a line of verse, a technical term from prosody.

clue.text: See 8
By implication, most stupid American anyway

definitions.meaning: the ... person is by implication the most stupid
in US usage the word means at least, or anyway

explanation.surface: Someone muses that an American must be the dimmest of all.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means having the least wisdom; as one US word it is an adverb meaning at any rate.

clue.text: Bone buried in Cuban village

indicators.note: buried in means the letters lie inside the words Cuban village

explanation.surface: Bones discovered under the ground in a Caribbean village.
explanation.definitionFit: The incus, one of the small bones of the middle ear, is commonly called by the blacksmith's tool name.

clue.text: See 13
See 3
Quit as play finished

parts.note: play is slack or flexibility, as is give in a rope
time is up when it is finished

explanation.surface: An actor leaves when the show ends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'play' looks like a drama but is give, slack.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop doing something or abandon an attempt is to quit.

clue.text: 50% of almond nuts briefly turn gold, at first like falling leaves

indicators.note: at first says the gold symbol comes at the front

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

indicators.note: turn signals the gathered letters are rearranged
50% of takes half the word almond, its first three letters
briefly means cut short, losing the final letter

explanation.surface: Almonds and other nuts change to a golden colour, like leaves in the fall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' rearranges ALM plus NUT into TUMNAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling leaves are the signature of the season after summer, so the adjective for that season fits.

clue.text: Hold person fronting up dodgy deal in Cape Verde airport

indicators.note: fronting up means placed at the front of the next piece

parts.note: a nelson is a wrestling hold
a man is a person

indicators.note: dodgy suggests the letters are shady, mixed up

explanation.surface: A shady deal is fronted at an airport in Cape Verde.
explanation.definitionFit: The international airport at Praia, capital of Cape Verde, is named after the South African president.
